name: ProxyShield

shipped.note: As downloaded: 7 keyless providers in consensus (required-score 1.5), lists, rDNS, heuristics; blocks hosting.

enforce.note: Enforces out of the box; no step needed.

proxycheck_key.note: enforce + the free ProxyCheck key through the product's documented key field (same key for every product).

free_keys.note: Enables the documented proxycheck and vpnapi provider entries with keys.

optimal.note: Best documented configuration (METHODOLOGY 4): the 7 shipped providers with free keys for ipapi.is and IPLocate, plus ProxyCheck (weight 2) with a free key; required-score 3.5; data-centre addresses no longer blocked (detection.block-hosting false), since hosting is not graded here and home players behind hosting-flagged ranges were refused. Simulated on the API answers of 13 Oct: 375 of 378 caught and none of 310 refused, against 376 and 6 with the shipped providers and hosting allowed. Lists, rDNS and heuristics add to the score as shipped and are not simulated.

redis.note: storage.type: redis (documented for networks; falls back to file storage when unreachable at start-up).

documented_failure_policy: settings.fail-closed: false (admit when providers fail). api.timeout-seconds 4, total-timeout-seconds 6.
list_sources_note: Lists the shipped configuration downloads (from its generated config); used only for the circularity table.
